honors.title: Best of Show Junior Duck Stamp Contest
honors.description:
https://www.flickr.com/photos/usfwshq/25918790323

This is the duck that competed in the 2015-16 Junior Duck Stamp Contest and received Best of Show in Minnesota. It continued on to compete in the National Junior Duck Stamp Contest in Washington DC and placed 16th in the nation. It is a bufflehead flying over water. I spent countless hours at my studio focusing on every detail of the duck. The wings took the longest because every individual feather had a unique shape and shading. I also spent a lot of time on the head. I really wanted to capture the beautiful colors of the bufflehead’s head so I made every stroke on its head a different color. I had used this technique in my previous duck and it had turned out beautiful. Since most ducks are mostly brown in color, when given the chance to add color, I made sure to make it vivid and stand out. In this duck I focused vibrant colors in the feet, head, and beak.
honors.issuer: Issued by U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service · Feb 2016

projects.title: Tetris
projects.description: Created Tetris game that included a 10x20 board and 7 rotating and falling pieces. Programmed an AI that found and implemented the best move for each random piece using board scoring system.

projects.title: AI
projects.description: I created a chess-like game that allowed two players to make moves and throw spears. Then coded an AI that predicted 10 steps ahead of the current state using the minimax algorithm of game theory.
